text:
incident-bot: PAGE: 2xx/5xx alert on /v1/embeddings — increased 503s (~12% p95) from region-us-west-2. Trigger: error-rate threshold crossed. Pager: maya.

maya: saw the page. I've started a quick triage.

jordan: I'm awake, can take secondary if you want.

maya: @jordan please take secondary. I'm primary.

tanvi: linking the dashboard — https://dash.redwood.internal/alerts/4990012345 — looks like embedding autoscaler oscillation + kube probe flaps.

maya: confirmed. pods are cycling in embeddings-scaler v2 group. Some nodes report failed liveness and then fail to rejoin.

samir: are we seeing increased latency before 5xx or just immediate failures?

maya: p95 latency up ~350ms on embedding path for 30m, then sudden spikes of 503s when pods get evicted.

jordan: I can temporarily route traffic to fallback-model:embedding-lite-1 to reduce customer impact. Should we flip?

maya: yes, do it. Low-risk route, same API surface but lower throughput per request. Post a rollback plan when done.

jordan: executing route switch now.

jordan: ```
# switch route to fallback
curl -X POST -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN' \
  https://control-plane.redwood/api/v1/routes/switch \
  -d '{"route":"embeddings","target":"embedding-lite-1"}'
```

jordan: switched. traffic rerouted ~30s ago. error-rate down to 2.1% now. :thumbsup:

maya: good. next, let's stabilize scaler. suspect recent change in probe timeout (t=10s -> t=3s) that made flaps worse.

tanvi: yep PR #8032 lowered probe time. I can revert to 10s or increase back. Which do you prefer?

maya: revert to 10s. Also mark the deployment paused so autoscaler doesn't aggressively spin up/down while we heal.

tanvi: pausing rollout and reverting probe config.```

tanvi: done. rollout paused, probes reverted. I also scaled embeddings-scaler to min=3 max=6 temporarily.

samir: we should also drain the few unhealthy nodes and force a clean join. I'll run the node drain -> restart sequence for the 3 affected machines (n-emb-07/08/12).

samir: ```
for n in n-emb-07 n-emb-08 n-emb-12; do
  ssh $n 'sudo systemctl stop embeddings.service && sudo reboot'
done
```

samir: nodes rebooting now. kube status shows them NotReady -> Ready expected in ~2-5m.

maya: good. customer impact: small set of high-volume customers saw intermittent 503s for ~25m. Support notified and we pushed a temporary fallback route.

jordan: I've posted a summary to #support-escalations and shared the mitigation steps + ETA to restore normal routing.

tanvi: monitoring logs for any remaining probe failures. so far 5xx rate back to baseline after route switch and probe revert.

maya: action items for next shift:
- primary: verify embedding-scaler pod stability and ensure nodes stayed healthy
- secondary: be ready to rollback route if error rate rises above 3% for 10m
- ops: follow up on PR #8032 probe change and add a canary for probe tuning
- infra: file a postmortem if we see reoccurrence after 24h

maya: assigning next shift: jordan will be primary from 08:00-16:00UTC tomorrow, tanvi secondary. I will stay available until handoff at 07:45.

jordan: acknowledged. I'll validate full traffic migration back after we confirm stable pods. Plan: migrate 25% -> 50% -> 100% over 10-min windows, watch error rate.

samir: I'll follow up and confirm node health in infra tickets (INV-499001).

incident-bot: NOTE: runbook referenced — https://runbooks.redwood/internal/embeddings-autoscaler — follow section 'Probe tuning and graceful rolling'.

maya: small note for the runbook: we should add a step to prescale when probe time is lowered, and a stability check before allowing autoscale up. I'll open a docs PR.

tanvi: nice. I also added a temporary dashboard panel for probe failures per node.

jordan: final status before handoff: 1) traffic on fallback-model, 2) probe reverted & rollout paused, 3) nodes rebooted and returning, 4) error-rate stable at ~1.8%.

maya: handing off to @jordan. if anything pops, escalate to @tanvi then @maya.

jordan: taking over. I'll update the morning log and close the page if stable for next 30m.

maya: thanks all. :heart:

jordan: copying next steps to the ticket and support note. Will close thread in 30m if no regressions.
